stories.label: Iran war Day 23: Bombing expands to western Iran, Pope Leo demands ceasefire
stories.summary: Day 23: Israel expands bombing to western Iran. Pope Leo XIV demands ceasefire in strongest papal intervention yet. Iran publicly running selective Hormuz blockade. War widening geographically, not narrowing — opposite trajectory from ceasefire.

stories.label: Hormuz economic fallout: UK drawn in, Iran selective blockade, Pakistan kerosene crisis
stories.summary: Hormuz crisis deepening: UK considering military deployment (minesweeping drones), Iran publicly confirms selective blockade letting allied ships through. Pakistan kerosene hiked Rs40/litre during Ramadan — war costs reaching poorest households. Iran transforming Hormuz from chokepoint into diplomatic sorting mechanism.

stories.label: Lebanon: 850,000 displaced in 10 days, 12 more medics killed
stories.summary: Lebanon humanitarian catastrophe accelerating: 850,000 displaced in 10 days (1 in 7 people). Israel killed 12 more paramedics in single strike, bringing monthly medic toll past 38. Systematic destruction of medical infrastructure amid active diplomatic push.

stories.label: Sudan: RSF drone campaign + cross-border violence into South Sudan
stories.summary: Sudan war metastasising: RSF launching drone campaign in Kordofan/Blue Nile. RSF-armed militias crossed into South Sudan, killing at least 169. Internal RSF tensions emerging.

stories.label: Western alliance fractures: Canada-Nordics bloc, Zelensky vs EU
stories.summary: NATO allies hedging against US unilateralism. Western alliance fragmenting under pressure of Iran war.

stories.label: BRICS silence tested: Iran pushes India to activate bloc against war
stories.summary: Iran publicly pressuring India (BRICS chair) to use the expanded bloc against the US-led war. BRICS has remained silent while one of its own members is being bombed. Tests whether BRICS is a real institution or a photo-op.

stories.label: Bangladesh: Jamaat threatens protests over Reform Council
stories.summary: Bangladesh's largest Islamist party threatening street protests if post-revolution Reform Council issue isn't resolved through parliament. Test of whether revolutionary institutional reforms survive traditional politics.

stories.label: Russia escalates Ukraine strikes under Iran war cover
stories.summary: Russia hitting Kyiv energy infrastructure with combined missile/drone attacks while global attention and air defence assets diverted to Iran war.

stories.label: China: PLA autonomous drone on Type 075 for South China Sea
stories.summary: New autonomous helicopter drone spotted on China's Type 075 amphibious assault ship. Advances PLA Navy autonomous capabilities while US carriers redeployed to Gulf.

stories.label: Israeli troops kill family in West Bank, soldiers say 'we killed dogs'
stories.summary: Escalating pattern: settlers shooting Palestinians in Qusra, IDF troops killing entire family including children and dehumanising victims. Occupation violence accelerating under Iran war cover.

stories.label: Egypt: Inflation + currency drain + Suez collapse
stories.summary: Egypt under triple economic pressure: inflation, shrinking reserves, Suez Canal revenue collapse.

stories.label: North Africa: Algeria and Morocco repositioning amid Iran war
stories.summary: Algeria and Morocco both recalibrating positions as Iran war forces strategic choices.

stories.summary: Greenland recorded warmest winter ever.

stories.summary: Denis Sassou Nguesso running for re-election after 40 years.

stories.label: Pakistan: Gas cuts + kerosene hike squeeze poorest during Ramadan
stories.summary: Pakistan's poorest hit twice: piped gas cut off for cooking, kerosene hiked Rs40/litre. Hormuz disruption reaching into kitchens during Ramadan.

stories.summary: Japan deployed domestically produced long-range missiles near East China Sea.
